118 finalized runs: 27 failures retained; 9 formal attempts implementation-invalid (D5) excluded from aggregation by error signature; 46/46 aggregated runs manifest-verified; 118=118 coverage reconciliation
Validation loss comparable across precisions after 100 steps (0.6B: 1.93 vs 1.81; 1.7B: 1.63 vs 1.55)
